parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is a small lever or handle made of stainless steel, located at the top of the faucet.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to adjust the water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main cylindrical body of the faucet made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the spout and switch, houses the internal water channels, and connects to the sink plumbing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural stability for the faucet.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is a tubular extension made of stainless steel that directs water flow from the faucet.
parts.Functional_description: It delivers water from the faucet to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally in some designs to direct water flow.
